reader_question: Of the people whose Medicaid or CHIP coverage came up for renewal, how many had a decision, how many were not cut off for paperwork, and how many kept coverage?
grade_line: Documented: renewal outcomes the states reported to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
title: Of 76.7 million Medicaid and CHIP renewals due from April 2023 to March 2024, 16.0 million ended for a procedural reason, and 49.0 million kept coverage.
measure_line: Medicaid and CHIP renewals due from April 2023 to March 2024, summed over the 12 months, by what happened to each, United States
notes: Each stage holds only the renewals left in the stage above it. Coverage ended for a procedural reason when the state stopped it for an administrative reason, as the states reported it, without finding that the person no longer qualified.
Pending renewals, 4.9 million, sit apart at the bottom: the states had not decided them three months after they were due.
The national figures are our sums of the states’ reports. The file ends with renewals due in March 2024, before every state had finished, and a person due in two of the months counts twice.
alt: Four bars from one left edge, each shorter than the one above: 76.7 million renewals due; 71.9 million decided; 55.9 million not ended for a procedural reason, after 16.0 million were, the loss drawn in the text’s ink; and 49.0 million that kept coverage, after 6.9 million were found ineligible. Below them, 4.9 million pending renewals sit apart.
chart_notes: The renewals ended for a procedural reason, the loss the title names, are in the text’s ink. The stages, the other loss and the pending renewals are gray.

table.caption: Medicaid and CHIP renewals due April 2023 to March 2024, by stage, United States

source_line: Source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Medicaid and CHIP Updated Renewal Outcomes, renewals due April 2023 to March 2024, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Stages summed by Oath & Action from the national rows; pending renewals set apart.

names.not_ended_procedural: Not ended for a procedural reason

notes_internal: Maker B, round 3. Data plan row 83 with change 11, rule 14.93. Draws the derived cms-medicaid-chip-renewal-funnel (P7-202, from cms-medicaid-chip-renewal-outcomes, P7-201): renewals due April 2023 to March 2024, nested stages from one base.

Data lead ruling (a): the named mark is the loss between decided and not ended for a procedural reason, 15,966,431, in the subject ink through labels.named (an area, no red); (b): stages in the light fill with the context edge (context ink on Charcoal) and their counts and shares printed, found ineligible in the track ink with the context edge, pending set apart below the stages after a gap, in the track ink with the context edge; automatic and form renewals in the table only.

Change 11 and Q-18: CMS’s own figures and period print; the difference from V7 I062’s KFF figures (more than 25 million disenrolled) is open question Q-18 for Dustin and is not drawn or corrected here.
